glyph_origin: Pictogram (象形) Outline of the chest, upper clothing. Compare to the upper part of 文. This pictogram 衣 can be split into two parts and hold another component (e.g., 裹, 衮, 褱, 襄, and 𧝑 as used in 㞡 > 展). See also the top component of 雜.
senses: [yì] (obsolete in standard Chinese, literary) to dress; to wear; to put on clothes
